name: Belvaros
tagline: The centre around Szechenyi Square and the mosque-church
description: Pecs's historic core, built around the square where the Ottoman mosque of Pasha Qasim stands converted into a church, with the cathedral, the early Christian necropolis and the Kiraly utca bar street all within a short walk. Compact, pedestrianised and the most attractive part of the city.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the square, the bars and the UNESCO tombs on foot
pros: Cathedral, mosque-church and the necropolis within ten minutes
Kiraly utca bars and restaurants at the door
cons: Student noise on Kiraly utca at night

name: Zsolnay Quarter and the Eastern Side
tagline: The converted ceramics works, now the city's cultural district
description: The former Zsolnay porcelain factory east of the centre, rebuilt for the 2010 Capital of Culture year into galleries, theatres, a university faculty and event spaces, with its own cafes and the distinctive glazed tiles everywhere. Housing nearby is a mix of older blocks at moderate rents.
bestFor: Stays that want the galleries and the events programme on the doorstep
pros: The Zsolnay Quarter's galleries, theatres and cafes
Fifteen minutes on foot to the main square

name: Mecsek Slopes and Havihegy
tagline: Climbing north towards the forest, with the view back over the city
description: The hillside streets rising north of the centre towards the Mecsek forest, with older villas, the Havihegy chapel and a view over the whole city and the plain beyond. The forest trails start where the houses stop, which is the district's main argument.
bestFor: Stays where a forest walk from the door matters more than a bar downstairs
pros: Views over the city and cleaner air
cons: Fifteen to twenty minutes down to the centre

name: Uranvaros
tagline: The western estates built for the uranium mine, cheapest rents
description: A large planned district west of the centre, built in the 1950s and 60s to house workers at the uranium mines that have since closed. It has its own shops, schools and swimming pool, frequent buses, and the lowest rents in the city by a wide margin.
bestFor: Long stays where the rent is the deciding factor
pros: Its own shopping, pool and services
cons: Twenty minutes from the historic centre

name: Villany Road and the Southern Approach
tagline: Towards the wine country, quieter and better value
description: The southern residential districts along the road out towards Villany, Hungary's best red wine region twenty minutes away. Mixed housing, local shops and a calmer pace, with the vineyards and the cellar villages reachable in half an hour by car for anyone who cares about the wine.
bestFor: Longer stays with a car and an interest in the wine country south of the city
pros: Villany and Szekszard wine country within half an hour
cons: A car makes a real difference here
Fifteen to twenty minutes into the centre
Little of interest within walking distance
